semantic_unit.target: Cargo stable DirectorySource behavior for extra on-disk files absent from .cargo-checksum.json files map
semantic_unit.action: Inspected exactly the same official stable Cargo DirectorySource source around update, download, and Source::verify; no Cargo command, dependency repository, second project/version, or second semantic leaf was inspected.
semantic_unit.result: DirectorySource::verify iterates only over cksum.files and hashes those listed paths. It does not enumerate pkg.root() to compare the on-disk tree against the checksum map and contains no rejection branch for an on-disk file that is absent from cksum.files. DirectorySource::download returns the already-loaded Package from the local directory source. Therefore an extra unlisted on-disk file is outside this verifier's checksum enforcement and is not rejected merely for being unlisted. Whether any specific unlisted file is later consumed by compilation, build scripts, manifests, or packaging is downstream behavior and was not established in this slice.

public_sources.observed: verify loops only over cksum.files entries; no reverse directory-tree membership check is present; download returns the stored local Package
